fact_sheet_status.notes: Excel Col H blank, but matching public folder found in Drive master folder

min_standing_note.value: Must be a full-time degree-seeking student at an exchange partner, have completed at least 1 year of college/university study, and be in good academic standing at the home institution.

min_gpa_host.notes: Augsburg Fact Sheet requires good academic standing at home institution without specifying a numeric host GPA cutoff; 2025-26 Drive file 'FACT SHEET_ WORLDWIDE_2025-26_INBOUND Exchange.docx.pdf' could not be downloaded.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Non-native speakers: TOEFL iBT 80 (pBT 550 / Essentials 8.5), IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 105, SAT EBRW 570, or ACT English+Reading 22; ISSS Exchange Flyer notes other measures of proficiency may also be accepted. No RHET 1020 waiver stated.

fall_term_dates.value: Fall 2026 final exams Dec 14–17, 2026 (full term start/end dates on Augsburg Registrar Academic Calendar).
fall_term_dates.notes: Fact Sheet (Augsburg University.pdf#page=2) displays AY 2024-2025 calendar; Registrar confirms AY 2026-2027 Fall exam dates.

spring_term_dates.value: Spring 2027 final exams May 3–6, 2027 (full term start/end dates on Augsburg Registrar Academic Calendar).
spring_term_dates.notes: Fact Sheet (Augsburg University.pdf#page=2) displays AY 2024-2025 calendar; Registrar confirms AY 2026-2027 Spring exam dates.

tuition_model.notes: Fact Sheet explicitly states 'Tuition (Paid to your home institution): $0'.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Fact Sheet (AY 2024-2025, #page=2) lists semester package costs ($3,494 Anderson double room + $2,817 mandatory 15+ meal plan + $900 student fees/books + $800 est. health insurance = $8,011/semester total, $7,211 excl. health insurance) rather than a monthly living rate.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: No official monthly living budget published; Fact Sheet (#page=2) gives AY 2024-2025 semester total of $8,011 USD incl. $800 est. health insurance ($7,211 excl. insurance).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Estimated student fees/books/materials $900/semester and health insurance $800/semester (AY 2024-2025 Fact Sheet); SEVIS I-901 fee required for J-1 visa.

housing_availability.notes: Exchange students apply to live on campus (Anderson Hall double room / Global Living Community, $3,494/sem AY 2024-25) with a mandatory 15-meal+ plan ($2,817/sem); Residence Life makes final housing decisions based on availability.

housing_notes.value: On-campus housing application for Anderson Hall dorm (double room $3,494/sem AY 2024-25) and required 15+ meal plan ($2,817/sem); Global Living Community LLC details at https://www.augsburg.edu/residencelife/living-learning-communities-llcs/.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: J-1 Exchange Visitor Visa using Augsburg-issued DS-2019 form; pay SEVIS I-901 fee and allow at least 1 month for travel/arrival planning.

english_course_list_url.notes: All standard undergraduate courses listed in the catalog are taught in English.

credit_system_and_load.value: US Semester Credits; full-time exchange course load 12–19 credits per semester (most courses are 4 credits).

campus_type.notes: ISSS Exchange Flyer states: 'A WELCOMING CAMPUS IN A LIVELY URBAN SETTING' (Minneapolis, MN).

international_support_services.value: International Student and Scholar Services (ISSS, Science Hall 112, isss@augsburg.edu): DS-2019/J-1 advising, mandatory international orientation, scheduled airport pickups, Global Living Community.
international_support_services.notes: Verified via WORLDWIDE_ISSS Exchange Flyer.pdf#page=1 (augsburg.edu/isss) and #page=2.

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall: Nomination Mar 1 (Fact Sheet/Flyer) or Mar 15 (official web), Application Mar 15 or Mar 21 (official web); Spring: Nomination Oct 1, Application Oct 15.
nomination_deadlines.notes: Augsburg ISSS J-1 Exchange page (https://www.augsburg.edu/isss/exchange-students-j-1-visa/) states Fall Nomination Mar 15 / Application Mar 21 and Spring Application Oct 15 (Nomination Oct 1).
